environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in us-east-1a, public subnet with ALB forwarding all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 4000. Security group sg-0bf42a allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. Origin is directly accessible via ALB DNS name. GraphQL introspection disabled in production but endpoint accepts arbitrary queries. The /usr/local/bin/generate-signed-url binary exists and accepts --path argument.

config.network: public ALB, no WAF, direct origin access
